buyer: The person who owns the AI coding bill at a 3-30 developer team (founder, tech lead, or agency owner) paying for an Anthropic API/Team org plus Copilot seats; find them among commenters on Claude Code billing issues #81703 and #62338 and on r/ClaudeAI spend threads
paymentMethod: Stripe Checkout payment link (subscription) with the Stripe customer portal for cancellation; no backend needed, access granted by email match or by hand for the first ten
mvpScope: Hosted, always-on alerts at 50/80/100% of a monthly budget across an Anthropic org and GitHub Copilot, via email and Slack, using read-only keys encrypted at rest; verified with real usage. Branch/task attribution, Cursor, OpenAI, M365, CSV and admin views are out until someone asks.
firstTenUsers: Week 1: message commenters on Claude Code issues #81703 and #62338 and on the BurnRate and RepoSpend threads who describe a surprise bill, and ask for a 15-minute call to watch them connect a key. Then post one demo in r/ClaudeAI asking who would connect a key. Charge the first five $9 by hand through the Stripe link; a refusal at $9 is the answer.

price.why: Only paid anchor found is ~$9 (AI Usage Tracker); free local trackers and vendor consoles cover the rest; evidence of willingness to pay is thin, so priced low and far under the $99 SpendGuard tier

mustHaveBeforeCharging: Live URL on a free tier working end to end with a real Anthropic org key and a real Copilot org
Alerts verified with real usage, not only a seeded key
Stripe Checkout payment link and customer portal
Privacy policy and terms pages, including key handling and deletion on request
Visible key-revoke instructions and read-only key guidance

risks: Evidence is weak: review scored 3/10, no named buyer, no one has offered money
Vendors already ship per-workspace limits and may add native cross-tool alerts
Free local trackers (ccusage, CodeBurn, RepoSpend, BurnRate) cover individuals, who have no budget
Holding customers' admin keys is a trust and security liability for a solo vendor
Most teams use only one or two agents, so cross-tool value is small
Overlaps David's pr-receipt idea, which is the sharper wedge with no key custody
killCriteria: Stop if after 3 weeks of outreach fewer than 5 named leads confirm a surprise bill last quarter and would connect a read-only key, or if nobody pays $9 within 5 conversations, or immediately if a vendor ships native cross-tool budget alerts. Then move effort to pr-receipt.
